mode: built-in imagegen; no CLI/API fallback or downloaded third-party artwork

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent 2D side-scrolling dark fantasy NPC sprite atlas, NOT concept environment.
Primary request: exactly eight full-body character sprites, four columns and two rows on a 1536 by 1024 canvas. Each of the two rows is ONE consistent adult identity in four different poses.
Composition: equal 384 by 512 cells, sprite centered horizontally in each cell, same head height and shoe baseline across every column, ample transparent padding. All characters face RIGHT in clear side/three-quarter side view, including idle and talk. Head-to-boots entirely visible. No props beyond worn accessories, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame borders or labels. Actual transparent background alpha, not white or checkerboard.

The walking poses must visibly differ in legs and arms; consistent body proportions, outfit, hair, face and scale throughout each row.

Row 1: practical woman with dark braided hair, teal shoulder shawl, layered gray-green tunic, brown belt pouch, trousers and worn leather boots. Row 2: lean older man with short gray hair and beard, dark moss hooded coat with hood down, rolled sleeves, ochre scarf, belt tool pouch, sturdy brown boots. Their costumes belong to underground village residents, not armored warriors.
